'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male [[Lollo Logistics]] [[NPC]] found speaking with '''Gidion''', an Academy Staff member. They can be found at the entrance way of [[Startorch Academy]] at night.

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Gidion:''' Running into [[Exiles]] every single day of the year, and each time they've got some new stunt...
:'''Danyu:''' Tell me about it! Royan Outcasts are way sneakier than the Exiles back where I'm from.
:'''Gidion:''' Yeah... I've dealt with Exiles. They just charged in like bulls. No brains to speak of.
:'''Danyu:''' Right! But Outcasts here? Smart and ruthless... Academy inventions, imported goods... they snatch everything.
:'''Gidion:''' Worst part is, they'll even butcher [[Exoswarm]]... right when the [[Exostrider]] needs them for repairs...
:'''Gidion:''' They've betrayed the Roya's duty and betrayed the Exostrider. Pfff!
:'''Danyu:''' Pfff!
----
;After completing {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:'''Gidion''': Okay, so the Threnodian has been driven back. Isn't it time the Spacetrek Collective finally did something about those Outcasts?
:'''Gidion:''' They loot. They raid. They trash everything. You've been putting up with them long enough, haven't you?
:'''[[Danyu]]:''' You preach to the converted, brother. But they used to be Roya. The Outcast situation is complicated... Hmph!
:'''Danyu:''' We're outsiders. There's only so much we can do.
:'''Gidion:''' So you're just going to continue letting them run wild?
:'''Danyu:''' No, we'll deal with it. But we need to talk to the Roya in Bjartr Woods first. We can't just lump everyone together and crack down...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* "Pfff" is a sound made by exhaling air to show discontent or disapproval.
